question: Related Questions Q. We had intended to purchase a flat about 10 years back and for the same we had given an amount of Rs.160000 (Rupees One Lac Sixty Thousand only) to the builder. Unfortunately, the building never got complete and the builder was not able to return us the money either. Now after 10 years or so, we were able to settle the matter through a shop which the builder gave to us in return of the money. We sold this shop and got back Rs.150000 (Rupees One Lac Fifty Thousand Only). My question is are we obliged to pay Zakat on this amount for the 10 years. If yes, please oblige by giving us the way of calculating the same. 2034 views Q. I have a question about ZAKAH in business: ALHAM DO LILLAH I am doing business which is giving me profits . Bismi-Allah-ArRahmaan-ArRaheem Kind Attention: Mufti in-charge : Fatwa Department : Darul Ifta Deoband, India Subject: Fatwa requisition regarding utilization of collected Zakah funds for public services Respected Sir, Assalamualaikum, Pleased to introduce myself as Mufti Myint Thein @ Mufti Abdussalaam, a Myanmar Muslim born and brought up in Yangon, Myanmar and together with other enthusiastic Muslims, has been actively and voluntarily conducting Islamic Religious activities such as proving free education on Quran and Hadiths as well as other Islamic educational knowledge and public services that would benefit towards Muslims living in Union of Myanmar as a minority community. Without taking much precious time of your esteemed self, kindly allow us to bring the subject and purpose of this mail. We would like to seek some religious verdicts (Fatwas) on some forms of utilizing collected Zakah funds. (that have been collected as a purpose of implementing Baitul Maal system within the community). Therefore, would like to request your esteemed self very humbly to kindly issue Fatwas upon implementing following listed ways of Zakah funds utilization. Kindly enlighten us and issue Fataawa: 1. whether it is permissible in Islam to utilize the collected zakah funds for public services such as building hospitals, clinics, schools, purchasing vehicles for funeral services, information services etc... 2. whether it is permissible to implement ?Micro Loan? system. 3. As we are living in a country where Muslims are minority, is it permissible to utilize the collected zakah funds for public services intended for both muslims and non-muslims such as relief services for earthquake victims, storm victims (?Nargis? victims), Tsunami victims etc? so that we muslims in the region could be understood by non-muslims much of whom have many misconceptions and negative thoughts towards Islam and Muslims. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 7755 Country: India Title: If I give (pay ) zakat (2.5 % of my earnings)every month, should I pay another 2.5% of my saving after one year also. Question: If I give (pay ) zakat (2.5 % of my earnings) every month, should I pay another 2.5% of my saving after one year also. Answer ID: 7755 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1772/1482=B/1429) After passing a year, if you have already paid the 2.5% of your total wealth during the 12 months then there is no need to give more in the name of Zakah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
